Fiber Quirk.name: Fiber Quirk
Fiber Quirk.description:
🧵 You move fibers: thread, cloth, rope, carpet and anything woven.

🌱 At the start you pull a person's own sleeves or pant legs tight to bind them, and feel through fabric where people are and what they carry.
📈 With training: people hauled by their clothes, curtain nets, rope swings, woven armor unpicked, cloth roofs over a street, every foe in sight held, armored clothing.
⚠️ Where nobody wears fabric, it has little to grip.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Activation Condition, since you must see or touch the fabric you move.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Best Jeanist (Fiber Master).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sleeve Lock, Weave Sense
Fiber Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user moves fibers touched or seen within about ten meters: thread, cloth, rope, felt, carpet. A new adult user grips clothing with a firm hand's strength (enough to pin arms or lock legs), spins cloth into a line that holds an adult, and feels through fabric where it is worn or weighted. More needs techniques. Limits: never hair, skin, wire, leather or rubber, so swimwear or hard armor gives little hold; blades cut threads, fire burns them, strong people tear free; cloth tight at the throat can choke, so trained users never bind there. Quirk Strain: light: binding a person, reading cloth; moderate: hauling someone clear, net, swing line; heavy: unweaving a room's woven guards, weaving a canopy; severe: signature hold, hardening a crowd's clothing. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed binding by clothing is unlawful restraint; police treat use to rob or trap as assault. Look: cloth ripples and tightens, threads twist in the air, fingers twitch with each pull.
